scope: Russian-to-Korean fictional application scenarios on Mac; 3 shuffled rounds per version; no real applicant records or external LLM

final_summary.meaning: Rule flags require review. No flags does not certify factual accuracy.

initial_outputs_rescored_with_final_rule.note: Same source text, final regex review criteria. Flag counts are not semantic accuracy.

changes: Kinship terminology avoids inventing sibling age or speaker gender when the Russian source is unspecified.
Explicit younger brother and older sister keep the supplied relationship.
Source uncertainty stays a statement rather than becoming a question in the regression example.
Software and application attachments remain distinct even within one answer.

review.reviewer: coding assistant; not independent bilingual expert
review.unseen_scenario: 6 model-translated answers and 2 passthrough values, first tested after prompt freeze; all checked rules clear in all 3 rounds; reviewed against source meaning

variations.uncertain-6: Optional explicit first-person pronoun; no observed change to negated direct observation.
variations.fresh-7: Passive versus implicit-subject phrasing; July 2024 and uncertainty retained.

limitations: No guarantee of semantic correctness from regex checks or repeatability.
Korean kinship phrasing is deliberately neutral and can sound awkward.
Word checks cover answer text and original page assets, not a new visual layout review.
Russian only; phone runtime and other source languages are not evaluated.

word_export_check.method: In-memory DOCX generation and XML/image asset checks
